resources.string: MPA verifies the Drive original before removing this downloaded file. Its cached preview, albums and photo information stay here. Offline pins, edits and active transfers prevent removal.

This uses saved Takeout sidecars for verified imported photos. It keeps your existing annotations and does not upload originals again. If no sidecar was saved, add the matching ZIP part first. Only names actually exported by Google can be recovered; these remain imported labels, separate from reviewed face groups.
